story.iWant: to verify my email address by clicking a link sent to me
story.soThat: I can confirm my identity and secure my account for full application access.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Implement client-side routing to handle the redirect URL from Supabase after email verification (e.g., /auth/verify to /login). (AC: 3) - Task 2: Implement UI to display a message indicating successful email verification (e.g., toast notification). (AC: 5) - Task 3: Implement logic to prevent login for unverified users and display an appropriate message. (AC: 4) - Task 4: Unit test client-side handling of the verification callback. - Task 5: E2E test the full email verification flow (register, receive email, click link, redirect, login attempt).

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I have just registered for a new account (story-1-001 completed successfully), When I check the email address I used for registration, Then I must find an email from the application containing a clear verification link. - AC 2: Given I click the verification link in the email, When the application processes the link, Then my account's status in `auth.users` table must be updated to `confirmed`. - AC 3: Given my email address has been successfully verified, When the application responds to the verification, Then I should be redirected to a login page or directly to the dashboard (if auto-login after verification is implemented, which is out of scope for this story but a future enhancement consideration). - AC 4: Given I attempt to log in with an unverified email address and correct password, Then the system must prevent login and display a clear message indicating that my email needs to be verified. - AC 5: Given my email has been successfully verified, Then a non-intrusive toast notification must appear, stating "Email verified! You can now log in."

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: New User Registration: User fills out and submits the registration form in the Next.js app. The `AuthManager` calls `supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })`. Supabase creates the user in the `auth.users` table (with `confirmed_at` as null) and sends a verification email.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: Email verification is mandatory. Users cannot log in until their email is verified, preventing sign-ups with fraudulent email addresses.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: AC2: After registering, the user receives an email with a verification link. AC4: A registered and verified user can log in with their email and password.

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: The `public.users` table stores user information and is linked to `auth.users` via a `UUID` primary key that is a foreign key to `auth.users(id)`. Row Level Security is enabled.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Non-intrusive "toast" notifications will be used. They will appear for 3-4 seconds and then fade automatically to confirm a successful action.

story-context.constraints: - Primary reliance on Supabase's built-in email verification mechanism. - Security of verification process is largely handled by Supabase. - The Next.js application must handle the redirect URL provided by Supabase after verification. - Toast notifications must be used for success feedback, appearing for 3-4 seconds.

interface.name: IAuthManager

tests.standards: Use testing frameworks like Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests. Create unit tests for client-side routing and UI components.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC1, 2) E2E test the full email verification flow (register, receive email, click verification link, observe status change). - (AC3) Unit test client-side routing logic for handling the Supabase redirect. - (AC4) Integration test a login attempt with an unverified email address to ensure it fails with the correct message. - (AC5) Component test the display of the success toast notification.
